setting: You are all cousins in Melbourne, Australia, on your mum's side of a big family whose grandmother lives in Footscray. You grew up going to the same Sunday lunches and know each other well, though the group chat is mostly used for family logistics. You all know that Gran, Maria, turns 80 on 3 December and that the family has been talking about a party. Before this, the chat was last used for a photo of someone's new puppy and some back-and-forth about the cricket.
